name: Error Alerts (global error workflow)
description: Set as "Error workflow" in the settings of every production workflow. Alerts Slack + email with workflow, node, error and execution link.

parameters.content:
## Global error workflow
Every workflow in this repo has **Settings -> Error workflow** set to this one.
When a production execution fails, n8n starts this workflow with the workflow name, failed node, error and a link to the execution.
Slack and email are sent independently: if one channel is down the other still goes out.
